row.notes: Returns an allocated array of 32-byte glyph records and writes the count. With no shaping font at shaper+0x28[font_idx] it emits one record per byte; otherwise it creates a HarfBuzz-style buffer (calloc 0xe0, max len 0x3fffffff), adds the UTF-8 range, shapes it with the font and converts glyph infos/positions (0x14 stride) to floats scaled by shaper+0x50[font_idx], storing glyph id, decoded codepoint, advances/offsets, cluster and tag.
